name: MedPiper Technologies, Inc
long_description:
MedPiper is building technology-driven commercial insurance and risk infrastructure.

We help businesses protect receivables, manage commercial risks and improve access to working capital. Our initial focus is trade credit insurance, embedded into lending, supply chain and B2B commerce workflows.

We combine insurance distribution, data-driven risk assessment, underwriting technology and automated servicing, with the long-term ambition of becoming a global commercial risk carrier.

Headquartered in the US, with operations in India. Since 2020, we've built insurance distribution, risk assessment and automated settlement infrastructure in partnership with leading insurers, enabling over $30M+ in insurance premiums.

Our longer-term ambition is to build a technology-native global commercial insurer covering trade, supply chains, cyber, specialty and emerging technology risks.

We're particularly interested in connecting with YC companies building in:
- AI infrastructure, data centers and hardware
- Manufacturing, robotics and industrial technology
- B2B commerce and global supply chains
- Lending, embedded finance and payments
- Commercial insurance and risk infrastructure

We'd love to speak with founders experiencing gaps in commercial insurance, receivables protection or access to financing as they scale.
one_liner: Insurance and risk infrastructure for businesses

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder and CEO of MedPiper (YC S20). Building technology-native commercial insurance and risk infrastructure, starting with trade credit and receivables protection.

Founder and operator with experience building regulated businesses, enterprise distribution, insurance infrastructure and data-driven products. Interested in the intersection of risk, capital, technology and global commerce.

founders.founder_bio: Currently Co-founder at Medpiper. Worked as a Business Consultant building products to enable clients streamline their sales and distribution process.
